name: io.github.chrischall/microsoft-teams-mcp
description: Microsoft Teams for Claude — read any chat or channel and its unread messages; send and react

environmentVariables.name: TEAMS_WS_PORT
environmentVariables.description: fetchproxy concentrator port used for the browser bridge. Defaults to 37149, the fleet-wide shared port.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_WS_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind interface for the bridge (default 127.0.0.1; a literal IP only, anything else is ignored). Keep on loopback — it exists for ONE topology: a hosted child in its own network namespace.

environmentVariables.name: FETCHPROXY_IDENTITY_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Where to store the long-term fetchproxy identity keypair (default ~/.fetchproxy/identity/; an absolute path only, anything else is ignored). Exists for a host that runs a separate child per caller, so they can share one identity.

environmentVariables.name: TEAMS_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: A pre-obtained Teams chat-service bearer token (the JWT itself). Leave blank to capture one from your signed-in Teams browser tab via the ContextMint Bridge extension.

environmentVariables.name: TEAMS_DISABLE_FETCHPROXY
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to never capture a token from the browser; then TEAMS_ACCESS_TOKEN is required. Leave blank.

environmentVariables.name: TEAMS_CHATSVC_REGION
environmentVariables.description: The Teams chat-service region in the API path. Defaults to amer. Leave blank unless your tenant lives elsewhere.

environmentVariables.name: TEAMS_CHATSVC_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Full override for the chat-service API base (default https://teams.cloud.microsoft/api/chatsvc/<region>/v1). Leave blank.

environmentVariables.name: TEAMS_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for the Teams tab to issue a chat-service request when capturing a token. Defaults to 30.

environmentVariables.name: TEAMS_TOKEN_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Set to false to keep the captured token in memory only. Defaults to on: it is cached so a restart within its ~23h lifetime needs no browser.

environmentVariables.name: TEAMS_TOKEN_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Where the captured token is cached. Defaults to ~/.microsoft-teams-mcp/token.json.
